step1_figure.circuit_type: Fully-differential two-stage CMOS op-amp with output-buffer CMFB under 50 mV input-referred offset in closed-loop configuration
step1_figure.description: The netlist implements the closed-loop test topology of Figure 26.45 (which embeds the op-amp from Figure 26.43). It includes a 50 mV input-referred offset voltage source in series with the non-inverting input, 20 kΩ input and feedback resistors, 250 fF load capacitors, 25 fF internal compensation capacitors, and output-buffer-based triode CMFB.

differential_output_offset.description: Differential output DC offset voltage resulting from the 50 mV input-referred offset

equation.explanation: Due to negative feedback through the resistor network, the input offset voltage is amplified by the non-inverting closed-loop gain (1 + Rf/Rin).
equation.assumptions: Infinite or very large op-amp open-loop gain; balanced feedback resistors Rin = Rf = 20 kΩ.

sky130_expected.calculation: With V_OS = 50 mV, R_in = 20 kΩ, and R_f = 20 kΩ: v_op - v_om = 50 mV * (1 + 20k/20k) = 50 mV * 2 = 100 mV = 0.100 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Finite open-loop DC gain (~400 to 500 V/V) causes a slight reduction below ideal 100 mV, but closed-loop gain is very close to 2.

output_cm_voltage.description: Common-mode output DC voltage enforced by the CMFB circuit

equation.explanation: The common-mode feedback loop monitors the average of the outputs via the resistive divider and adjusts the output buffer bias to force the output CM voltage to V_CM.
equation.assumptions: CMFB loop has sufficient DC loop gain and is stable.

sky130_expected.calculation: V_CM is set to 500 mV (0.500 V). Thus V_CM,out = (v_op + v_om) / 2 = 500 mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The CMFB differential amplifier senses V_CM = 500 mV and balances the NMOS pull-down current in the output buffers around 500 mV.

single_ended_output_vop.description: Positive single-ended output voltage at DC balance with 50 mV offset

equation.explanation: The output offset is distributed symmetrically around V_CM by the CMFB network.
equation.assumptions: Ideal CMFB forcing output average to V_CM = 500 mV.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Offset shifts v_op upward by +50 mV relative to V_CM.

single_ended_output_vom.description: Negative single-ended output voltage at DC balance with 50 mV offset

equation.explanation: The complementary output is shifted downward by the same amount to maintain the common-mode level at V_CM.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Offset shifts v_om downward by -50 mV relative to V_CM.

op_amp_inverting_input_voltage.description: DC voltage at the inverting input terminal (v_m) of the op-amp

equation.formula: v_m = (V_OS / 2) * (R_in / (R_in + R_f)) + V_CM * (R_in / (R_in + R_f)) + V_CMI * (R_f / (R_in + R_f))
equation.explanation: Determines the internal common-mode level of the input pair to verify the input transistors remain in saturation.
equation.assumptions: Input common-mode V_CMI = V_CM = 500 mV, Rin = Rf = 20 kΩ.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Direct voltage divider calculation from the closed-loop feedback equations.

differential_dc_gain.description: Open-loop differential DC voltage gain of the op-amp core

equation.explanation: Two-stage op-amp open-loop gain is the product of first-stage cascode gain and second-stage common-source gain. Textbook shows peak Av ≈ 400 V/V (52 dB).
equation.assumptions: Transistors biased in active saturation with VDD=1.8V.

sky130_expected.reasoning: For 1 µm gate lengths in SKY130 with cascoding on stage 1 and moderate second stage gain, gain typically lands between 200 and 800 V/V (46 - 58 dB).

unity_gain_frequency.description: Unity-gain frequency (gain-bandwidth product) of the differential op-amp

equation.explanation: Determined by the transconductance of the input differential pair and the Miller compensation capacitance.
equation.assumptions: Input tail current ~ 40 µA (20 µA per branch), W/L = 10/1, Cc = 25 fF.

sky130_expected.reasoning: High speed achieved due to very small 25 fF compensation capacitors.

quiescent_current_vdd.description: Total quiescent current drawn from VDD including bias circuitry and op-amp core

equation.explanation: Total supply current measured from the positive supply rail VDD.
equation.assumptions: No external DC load resistors attached to ground.

sky130_expected.calculation: Textbook states ~250 µA total (~200 µA for op-amp, ~50 µA for bias circuit).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Stage 1 branches: 4 x 20 µA = 80 µA; Stage 2 buffers: 2 x 60 µA = 120 µA; Bias generator: ~50 µA.

power_dissipation.description: Total static power dissipation at nominal supply voltage

equation.explanation: Product of supply voltage and total current drawn from VDD.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Direct product of nominal VDD (1.8 V) and typical current (250 µA).

settling_time.description: Large-signal differential settling time to 1% of final value

equation.explanation: Time required for the differential output step response to settle to within 1% of final value.
equation.assumptions: Input differential pulse step of 200 mV (400 mV to 600 mV).

sky130_expected.calculation: Textbook specifies settling times of approximately 1 to 2 ns.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Driven by GHz unity-gain bandwidth and 25 fF / 250 fF capacitive loading.

step3_testbench.description: Complete ngspice simulation testbench measuring DC operating point, offset amplification, CMFB common-mode regulation, supply current and power, open-loop AC gain/bandwidth, and transient step response with settling time.
